mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_rag_index_task (task_id, scope, file_id, file_name, status, chunks, message, attempts, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{scope}, #{fileId}, COALESCE(#{fileName}, ''), #{status}, COALESCE(#{chunks}, 0), COALESCE(#{message}, ''), COALESCE(#{attempts}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, scope, file_id, file_name, status, chunks, message, attempts, created_at, started_at, finished_at, progress, stage, index_signature FROM zzl_ai_rag_index_task WHERE scope = #{scope} AND file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT task_id, scope, file_id, file_name, status, chunks, message, attempts, created_at, started_at, finished_at, progress, stage, index_signature FROM zzl_ai_rag_index_task WHERE scope = #{scope} AND task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1

SELECT task_id, scope, file_id, file_name, status, chunks, message, attempts, created_at, started_at, finished_at, progress, stage, index_signature FROM zzl_ai_rag_index_task WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE zzl_ai_rag_index_task SET progress=#{progress}, stage=#{stage}, index_signature=#{indexSignature} WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzl_ai_rag_index_task WHERE scope = #{scope} AND file_id = #{fileId}
